title: Automatic Door Opening and Closing
summary: Feedback centers on the G70's automatic doors, with praise for convenient hands-free opening and brake-triggered closing alongside complaints about inconsistent operation and hard-to-reach controls, while many fragments are too brief or ambiguous to classify clearly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the automatic doors for convenient self-opening operation and easy closing by pressing the brake.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe automatic doors that sometimes fail to open or close properly and buttons placed in inconvenient locations.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention doors opening, limited opening distance, sensor problems, or creaking, but the short or unclear wording makes sentiment hard to assign consistently.

limitations: The sampled examples are heavily dominated by undetermined fragments, so many mentions lack enough context to identify a clear evaluation.
Negative evidence is limited to a small number of examples, so the specific complaint themes may be incomplete.
Some undetermined fragments describe possible problems or features in very short phrases, which makes interpretation uncertain.
